yt.title: The net worth that puts you in the top 10% at 65–74 (Fed 2025) #Shorts
yt.description:
Households 65–74, Federal Reserve 2025 SCF (our calculation): bottom 25% under $118k, median $431k, top 25% from $1.3M, top 10% from $3.6M.

Full video: https://youtu.be/UAf_G-mu7cc

Sources: Federal Reserve Board, 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances, summary extract public data (our calculation with survey weights; 2025 dollars).
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
Narration is AI-generated.
